results.description:
Your Apple Watch collects thousands of data points a day. Athlytic turns them into one clear answer: how ready you are, how hard to go, and how to recover.

RECOVERY: Every morning Athlytic reads your overnight HRV and resting heart rate against your own baseline and tells you how recovered you are. On Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4, Recovery uses Apple's new Recovery HRV.

EXERTION and TARGET EXERTION: Your cardiovascular load is tracked 24/7 and scored 0 to 10. Each day you get a Target Exertion range that fits your Recovery, so you know when to push and when to hold back.

WORKOUT SUGGESTIONS: Based on your target zone and the workouts you actually do, Athlytic suggests what to do today, for how long, and how hard. Build a structured workout, or import a plan from a screenshot, and send it to your Apple Watch with warm-up, repeats, rests, and cool-down.

ATHLYTIC AGE: One number for your fitness, built from your resting heart rate, VO2 max, sleep, body composition, steps, training minutes, and heart rate recovery. See which lever moves it most, then tap What if to try changes before you make them.

BATTERY and STRESS: Watch your energy fill and drain through the day, and see when your heart rate ran above your baseline so you know what stressed you.

TARGET SLEEP: A nightly sleep goal and target bedtime built from today's Recovery, Exertion, and sleep debt.

SLEEP: Sleep performance, stages, restorative sleep, sleep debt, consistency, latency, efficiency, heart rate dip, and overnight charts of HRV, heart rate, respiratory rate, and blood oxygen.

24/7 HEALTH MONITOR: HRV, resting heart rate, blood oxygen, respiratory rate, wrist temperature, and menstrual cycle, each checked against your normal range, with optional alerts when something is off.

JOURNAL: Log caffeine, alcohol, travel, illness, and dozens more, then see exactly how each one moves your Recovery and Sleep.

WORKOUTS: Live heart rate zones, Effort score, and intensity on your wrist. Afterward, a full breakdown with cardio fitness, heart rate recovery, splits, personal records, best efforts, and how the session compared with your typical one.

TRENDS: Recovery vs. Exertion coaching, training load and training load ratio, weekly activity goals, energy consumed and burned, heart rate recovery, and cardio fitness over time.

ASK ATHLYTIC and SIRI: Ask questions about your Recovery, Sleep, Stress, and workouts in plain language with Ask Athlytic, powered by Apple Intelligence. Or just ask Siri for your Recovery, Sleep, Training Status, planned workouts, and more, without opening the app.

24 IPHONE WIDGETS, 16 WATCH COMPLICATIONS: Recovery, Exertion, Sleep, Battery, Stress, Training Load, Net Energy, Macros, Steps, Cycle, Daily HRV and Heart Rate charts, and Lock Screen widgets for Recovery, Exertion, and Stress.

Notes:
• An Apple Watch is needed for most features, since HRV and resting heart rate come from the watch. Some third-party wearables that write HRV to Apple Health also work.
• Athlytic reads its data from the Health app and will ask permission for each data type it uses.

results.releaseNotes:
New & Improved

- Added calendar syncing, which adds your training plans and scheduled workouts to Google Calendar or Apple Calendar. Enable calendar syncing in Settings > Bevel Intelligence > Calendars.
- Added in-app Bevel Intelligence notifications. Leave a chat while a response is generating, and a preview appears when it's ready. Tap it to jump back into the chat.
- Improved data loading speed significantly across the app, from cold launches to dashboard refreshes.
- Improved the Bevel Intelligence chat toolbar and animations.
- Improved Cardio fastest-time personal records to use elapsed time instead of active time, so pauses are included. Existing records are recalculated automatically.
- Added support for setting a lower maximum heart rate and lactate threshold heart rate in Heart Rate Zones settings, for people taking medications such as beta blockers that lower their heart rate.
- Improved German localization across the app.

Bug Fixes

- Fixed a bug where Cycle Tracking showed no phases, or dropped an ovulation estimate, for cycles with a short luteal phase.
- Fixed a bug where perceived effort edits on Garmin and other third-party workouts did not stick. The effort card is now disabled until the workout has exercises.
- Fixed a bug where indoor walks, runs, and rides logged or edited in Bevel were saved to Apple Health as outdoor workouts. Strength workouts recorded on iPhone are now saved as indoor too.
- Fixed several Bevel Intelligence bugs, including chats getting stuck thinking without replying, coaching cards and notifications showing outdated info or arriving twice, scheduled workouts appearing as rest days, and food logging issues.
- Fixed a bug with nutrition food log deletions not applying correctly after app reinstall.
- Fixed a bug where Garmin Connect integration temperature data was missing.

Bevel is the #1 app for improving your health, performance, and longevity, trusted by hundreds of thousands and backed by science.

From sleep and recovery to stress and strength training, Bevel transforms your health data into personalized guidance you can actually use. Whether you're training for something big or just trying to feel better day to day, Bevel helps you move smarter, recover faster, and live longer.

FEATURES

Bevel Intelligence: Your smart health engine. Bevel Intelligence connects the dots across your data to give you instant feedback and personalized recommendations. It suggests when to train, when to rest, and what's helping or hurting your progress.

Recovery Score: Your daily readiness, simplified. Avoid overtraining, prevent injury, and build sustainable habits by seeing how prepared your body is to perform each day.

Sleep Score: Track and understand your sleep with a single number. Bevel analyzes your sleep stages, duration, and interruptions to reveal how well you're resting. A smart alarm wakes you at the optimal moment in your sleep cycle.

Strain Score: Measure how hard your body is working throughout the day. Your Strain Score is personalized based on your sleep and recovery, helping you train at the right intensity without burning out.

Nutrition Score: Log meals via Barcode Scan, Image Search, Recipe Creation, Describe Meal, or search our database of 6 million+ foods. Set calorie, macro, and nutrient goals in one place. Bevel also supports glucose tracking to see how food affects your metabolism.

Stress Score: See how stress shows up in your body with a real-time score. Understand your stress patterns during sleep, workouts, and daily life.

Strength Builder: Train smarter with Bevel's strength trainer. Choose from 700+ exercises, sync workouts between watch and phone, and get real-time feedback on muscular strain. Generate custom plans or log past workouts to track progress.

Energy Bank: Your body's battery. Bevel combines recovery, sleep, strain, and stress into a single metric to show how your energy builds and drains throughout the day.

Biological Age: Discover how old your body really is. Bevel calculates your biological age using key health markers like sleep, activity, resting heart rate, and more. Track how lifestyle changes move the needle and see how your choices affect aging.

Health Records: Bring your medical data into Bevel. Import lab results, bloodwork, and clinical records to get a complete picture of your health in one place. Understand what your numbers mean and track changes over time.

Journal:
Track habits that impact your health. Log hydration, sunlight, screen time, and more. See how small behaviors add up and affect your sleep and recovery.

SUBSCRIPTION AND TERMS

Bevel is available for free with the option to upgrade to Bevel Pro with an auto-renewing subscription. You may switch off auto-renew in your Apple ID Account Settings.

Purchases of premium subscriptions will be charged using your Apple ID upon confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew on a weekly or yearly basis, unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. If canceled, subscriptions remain valid until the end of the current period, and any unused portions are not valid for a refund.

By completing your purchase, you affirm your understanding of the following:

Privacy Policy: https://docs.bevel.health/privacy-policy

Bevel is not a medical device and is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, monitor, or prevent medical conditions or illnesses. Always consult your physician first. All information provided is for general informational purposes only.

All your health in one app: chronic stress & energy tracker

Trusted by over 20 million people, featured in the App Store under Apps We Love, and collaborating with 30+ universities, including Harvard Medical School, Arizona State University, and Johns Hopkins, to advance health science.

Welltory helps you understand your heart

Sometimes your body feels hard to decode. Welltory turns its signals into insights to help you manage chronic stress, track energy reserves, navigate fatigue, and take charge of your long-term health.

By analyzing heart rate variability, a proven health marker backed by 20,000+ studies, Welltory shows how your nervous system, sleep, and lifestyle impact how you.

Track and reverse chronic stress

Daily stress impacts your energy reserves, especially if you’re living with POTS, Long COVID, or ME/CFS. Turn your Apple Watch or wearable into a stress monitor. See how work, emotional pressure, and physical effort affect your baseline, and catch stress spikes before they take a toll or trigger a crash.

Get your energy back

Welltory tracks your body’s daily battery level in real time so you can pace your day, prevent sudden crashes, and know exactly when to push or pause.

Track sleep & recovery

Find out what’s disrupting your deep sleep, evaluate nighttime recovery, and access science-backed audio programs designed to help you fall asleep faster and wake up refreshed.

Decode your health patterns

Log flare-ups, crashes, and life events in your Journal. Connect your symptoms to HRV, stress, and recovery trends so you can spot hidden triggers and pace your energy with confidence.
Track your migraines
Log episodes, symptoms, and intensity alongside sleep and heart rate data to identify what triggers your migraines and map your patterns over time.
Turn data into insights
Stop juggling single-purpose health apps. Connect 1,000+ devices, wearables, and apps, including Apple Watch, Oura, Garmin, meditation tools, and lab results, into one smart health hub.

Monitor blood pressure & heart health

Keep tabs on hypertension, resting heart rate, and cardiovascular trends. Log readings manually or sync a blood pressure monitor to generate detailed PDF health reports you can share with your doctor.

Note: Welltory reads HRV via camera or wearable sensors; it does not measure blood pressure directly via phone camera or Apple Watch.

Track workouts & move without crashing

Balance exercise with proper recovery. Welltory tracks active movement, including daily chores, walking, and intense workouts, and sets personalized longevity targets to help you avoid burnout.
